metric_contract.nrmse: RMSE in original frozen observation coordinate / development SD; record mean then site mean then subject mean
metric_contract.numerical_acceptance: solver convergence and original-coordinate KKT, followed by independent reintegration/metric audit; rejected records remain in planned denominators and original evidence is unchanged
metric_contract.repeat: maximum 2|A-B|/(|A|+|B|) across released parameters; site mean within subject then median/P90 across subjects
metric_contract.effective_pair: both accepted, every released parameter >=5% log-interior, worst relative difference<=.20, every record/modality fit and transfer <=N0+.01; fixed/shared null excluded
metric_contract.boundary_rate: among finite paired parameter estimates; missing estimates are separately retained as ineffective pairs in the full registered denominator
metric_contract.intervals: subject bootstrap per dataset/site; no pooled cross-dataset ICC; frozen calibration not refitted
metric_contract.profile: sampled engineering tolerance sets; no confidence interval/global optimality/nonexistence claim

P1_tau.definition: N0 near boundary and an accepted profile inner point improves original objective by >1% of frozen P0 reference

P1_beta.definition: N0 near boundary and an accepted profile inner point improves original objective by >1% of frozen P0 reference

P2.definition: N0 near boundary and an accepted profile inner point improves original objective by >1% of frozen P0 reference

P3.definition: N0 near boundary and an accepted profile inner point improves original objective by >1% of frozen P0 reference

conditional_followups.length_stopping_reason: no continuous arm retained under joint repeat/fidelity/transfer development criteria

parameter_expansion.criterion: P2 synthetic recovery including planned failure denominator; median effective information eigenratio > 1e-4
parameter_expansion.scope: admit P3 diagnostic; no parameter qualification

selected_synthetic.calibration_contract: same generator/noise/processing; fit pooled center and paired-log-crossmoment scale from extra training records at each heterogeneity level; no scored identity or individual truth used
selected_synthetic.reason: only retained sharing strengths require additional recovery calibration; rejected measured arms do not advance

synthetic_information_calibration.interpretation: known synthetic observation-noise variance times inverse effective data curvature; local linear diagnostic at fitted interior estimates, not a measured physiological bound
synthetic_information_calibration.formula: var(log theta_A-log theta_B) approximately sigma^2 * diag(Ieff_A^-1 + Ieff_B^-1)
synthetic_information_calibration.inclusion: both accepted, all parameters 5% interior, positive full-rank effective information; excluded pairs are not recovery successes

headline_conclusion: 12个数据集×参数层次中，0个观察最佳结果同时满足数值通过率≥95%和重复差异中位≤20%。实测个体生理准确性仍未建立；共享的稳定收益须与真实差异恢复分开判断。
final_findings: 观察排名最高为P1_tau／N0：重复差异中位51.5%，5%近界配对47.8%，有效配对8/69。不能据此认定个体生理真值已恢复。
观察排名最高为P1_tau／N0：重复差异中位45.5%，5%近界配对45.0%，有效配对12/60。不能据此认定个体生理真值已恢复。
观察排名最高为P1_tau／N0：重复差异中位42.0%，5%近界配对54.3%，有效配对7/35。不能据此认定个体生理真值已恢复。
保留条件重建和带失败标记的参数摘要；个体生理解释仍需独立约束。先解决共同内点与差异恢复问题，再扩大自由参数或推广强共享。
unexecuted_steps_text: N2新求解器未触发；连续长度扩展未触发；未保留的单项不进入评价，也无组合臂。未训练tokenizer或执行其他协议的受保护评价。
